scenes.title: 2:47 AM — Room 304 Ka Lifafa
narration: *Barish ki awaaz helmet ke andar se bhi aa rahi hai. Tum corridor ke end mein khade ho — haath mein ek kala lifafa, aur ek 18,000 rupaye ka 'tip' jo app ne 'incentive' kehkar bheja hai. Room 304 ka darwaaza band hai, aur andar se koi awaaz aa rahi hai. Dheemi. Do baar. Teesri baar nahi.*
*notification:*
Tokro: "'Order 304-B: no photo, no signature 🙌 Tap DELIVERED and ride home. Your rating is safe with us!'"
*Tumhara thumb 'Delivered' ke button par rukta hai. Tumhe apne pichle 3 NPL-4 orders yaad aate hain: teeno baar tumne poocha nahi. Teeno baar 18 hazaar aa gaye.*
*Darwaaze ke neeche se ek kaagaz ka tukda sarakta hai — andar se kisi nephenkadiya. Uspar ek line hai, marker se:*
*kaagaz par likha hai:*
Tara: "'Police mat bulao. Darwaza kholne ki koshish mat karo. Bas ek kaam karo — meri jeb se phone nikal kar lobby ke phone par 2 number dial kardo.'"
*Aur theek tab, lifafa tumhare haath mein thoda halka lagta hai — kyunki usmein kaagaz hai, cash hai, par koi khana nahi. Tumhe pehli baar ehsaas hota hai: tum 'rider' nahi ho. Tum 'handover' ho.*
fallbackLines: *Corridor ki light 4 baar flicker karti hai. Har baar tum apna haath upar karte ho, aur har baar tumhara haath wapas aa jaata hai.*
*doosra notification:*
Tokro: "'Heads up ⚠️ This order is Priority. Reporting may affect your tier. 14 min on-site detected — continue?'"
*Neeche, lobby mein, night manager ki chhati uth-uthkar saans le rahi hai. Koi nahi jaag raha. Tumhara phone 34% par hai — 1 ghanta, ya 6 minute ki call.*

scenes.title: Wapsi Ka Raasta
narration: *'Delivered'. App turant 18,000 ka confirmation deta hai — aur ek 'tip bonus' bhi, 2,000. Tum elevator ke paas jaate ho. Lift khaali hai, chamak rahi hai, aur usmein tumhare alava koi nahi hai.*
*'You're on fire! 🔥 4.9 rating maintained. Next priority order unlocks at 2 more completions.'*

*Lift 2nd floor par rukti hai — doors khulte nahi khulte band ho jaate hain. 2 second. Tumhe lagta hai koi dekh raha hai. Aaine mein tumhara chehra hai. Aur tumhare kandhe par woh kala lifafa — nahi, lifafa toh andar ja chuka hai. Tumhara bag khaali hai. Par tumhe abhi bhi bhaari lag raha hai.*

*Parking mein ek car start hoti hai. Uspar 'function hall' ka sticker hai — 3:00 AM, 'private event'. Tumhare kaan mein tumhari maa ki awaaz aati hai: 'beta, tu raat ko kaam kyun karta hai?'. Pehli baar tumhe iska jawab nahi milta.*
*Phone bajta hai. Hub. Guddu Bhai.*

Guddu Bhai: "Bhai, 'done' kar diya? Shukriya yaar. Ek kaam — tu aaj raat tapri se nikalte waara camera side se jaana. Junction wala camera kal se 'on' hai. ...Bhai, main kuch nahi bol raha. Bas bola."
*Aur theek tab — lobby se awaaz. Ek cheekh nahi. Ek kaanch ka tootna. Aur fir 3 second ki bilkul khamoshi, jo cheekh se buri hoti hai.*
fallbackLines: *App: 'Rate your delivery?' Tumhe lagta hai tumhara haath jawab de dega. Woh nahi deta.*
*Barish tez ho gayi hai. Tumhara helmet ka camera 12 minute ki clip record kar chuka hai. Tum abhi tak usse band nahi kar paaye.*
*'We noticed you are still on-site. Tap to confirm exit.'*

scenes.title: Naam Ke Saath
narration: *3:44. Tapri. Tum Ishaan ke saamne baithe ho, aur tumne apna naam diya. Statement: 6 page, 2 hour. Tumhari awaaz 4 baar toot'ti hai — aur har baar Ishaan ruk jaata hai, aur poochhta hai: 'paani?'. Kisi aur ne poocha hota toh tum aur toot'te.*
*Kal subah 5:04 — '27' ka order hub ke queue mein 'cancelled' dikhta hai. 2 log, 1 girl 19 saal, Nashik. Teeno 'recovered'. Ek naam, 'Mr. Z.', arrest. Doosra 'absconding'.*
*Tumhara account: 2,000 cut, tier review 90 din, 1 'final warning'. App ne tumhe 4 baar 'partner' kaha hai, aur ek baar bhi 'thank you' nahi.*
*subah 7:11, call, 4 second:*
Guddu Bhai: "'Bhai. Main jaanta hoon. Main bhi bolunga. 2 hafte baad. Abhi 2 bachche hain ghar pe. 2 hafte, bhai. Bas.'"

*Tara ka message, 4 hafte baad: 'Bhaiya. Loan khatam. Witness banungi. Ek shart: aapko court mein nahi aana. Main akele jaungi. Aap bus chalaao. Yahi kaafi hai. Aur — 6:15 ka ticket abhi bhi mere paas hai. Cancel nahi kiya.'*
*Case: 4 saal. Tumhara rating: 4.6. Tumhara naam: 6 page. Aur tumhare andar ek aisi shanti jo 3 saal ki 4.9 rating mein nahi thi.*
*Aur haan — 'Night Priority' tier band ho gaya. 62 riders ko 3 din baad ek email aaya: 'We have removed a category based on feedback.' Koi feedback nahi tha. Sirf tumhara naam tha.*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — naam ke saath.*

scenes.title: Gayab Ka Kaagaz
narration: *Card Ishaan ke haath mein. Tumhara naam kahin nahi. 5:40 tak app ka GPS log overwrite ho jaata, par Ishaan ne 3:52 par log 'download' kar liya — ek constable, ek USB, aur ek 'anonymous tip' ka number.*
*'27' kal subah cancel hota hai. 40 log 'recovered' — 3 din ka kaagaz, 4 mahine ka process, 1 witness jo kabhi kisi ke saamne nahi aati (Tara ne apna decision nibhaaya).*

*Tumhara account: 'handover failed' nahi, kyunki 'delivered' record hai. 20,000 bhi nahi, kyunki 18,000 'tip' ka source 'unverified' mark ho gaya. Tumhe 3 hafte tak 18,000 ka 'recover' notice milta hai. Tum nahi dete. Kuch nahi hota.*

*Ishaan ek baar milta hai, 6 hafte baad, wahi tapri. Woh kehta hai: 'Tumhara naam maine sirf ek jagah likha hai — 'source, verified'. Tumhe pata hai iska matlab? Matlab case chalega, aur tum safe ho. Matlab mujhe bhi pata hai maine tumhe bachaya hai ya becha. Theek. Chal, jao.'*

*Aur tum jaate ho. Har raat. 2:11, 3:00, 5:40. Tumhare bag mein khaali lifafa hamesha hota hai — 'weight check' ke liye, tum kehte ho. Tumhe pata hai tum jhooth bol rahe ho. Tumhe pata hai yeh theek hai.*

*Guddu Bhai, 2 hafte baad, hub se nikalta hai — resignation, 1 page. Usne Ishaan ko 4 riders ke naam de diye. App ne usse 'exit feedback' bola. Tumhe 3 din baad ek message aata hai: 'Bhai. Ab so sakta hoon. Shukriya. — G.'*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — khaamosh jeet.*

scenes.title: 20,000 Ka Sooda
narration: *5:40. App: 'Handover failed. ₹2,000 deducted. 18,000 flagged for recovery. Tier review: 90 days.' Tum apne kamre mein baithe ho, phone 0%. Card drawer mein hai — 12 minute ki clip, abhi bhi.*

*Tum kuch nahi karte. Aur duniya kuch nahi karti. Signal pe U-turn nahi liya, isliye Tara ne khud apna kaam kiya: woh 6:15 ki bus pakad gayi — usne counter wale ko 400 diye, ticket kaata, aur uski behen ne use station se uthaya. Kuch bhi dramatic nahi. Bus. Ghar. Neend.*

*2 hafte baad: ek order usi hotel ke 2nd floor se. Tumhe 2 second lagta hai accept karne mein. Tum accept karte ho. 18,000 ka 'incentive' dobara aata hai. Tum 2,000 ka 'recovery' auto-debit se chhod dete ho.*
*'Welcome back, {{playerName}}! 🔥 You're on fire again.'*

*Aur ek raat — 3 mahine baad, 2:11, barish — tumhara phone par 'unknown number' se ek line aati hai: 'Bhaiya. Loan abhi bhi hai. Main witness nahi bani. Aapne card kabhi nahi diya. Koi baat nahi. Bas ye jaan lijiye ki aapne mujhe sirf 20,000 mein nahi, 2 minute mein nahi — 12 minute mein chhoda hai. Woh clip aapke paas hai. Aaj bhi hai. Aap decide karo, agli baar. — T.'*
*Tum phone band kar dete ho. Tum shift khatam karte ho. Tum ghar aate ho. Card ab bhi drawer mein hai. Aur tumhe pata hai — yahi sabse mehnga hissa hai: ki woh ab bhi wahin hai.*
fallbackLines: *Kahani poori — har cheez chukayi gayi, sirf ek nahi.*

endings.title: Naam Ke Saath
endings.description: Tumne witness banna chuna: 2,000 gaye, tier gaya, case aaya. Tara ne shart rakhi — woh akele court jaayegi, tum bus chalao.

endings.title: Gayab Ka Kaagaz
endings.description: Anonymous tip se '27' cancel hua, 40 log recovered. Tumhara naam sirf 'source, verified' bana raha.

endings.title: 20,000 Ka Sooda
endings.description: Paisa aaya, card drawer mein pada hai. Tara zinda hai, par witness nahi bani. Abhi nahi.
